title: Deep Unsupervised Learning using Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics
summary: Jascha Sohl-Dickstein, Eric A. Weiss, Niru Maheswaranathan, and Surya Ganguli submitted 'Deep Unsupervised Learning using Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics' on March 12, 2015. The paper describes an iterative forward diffusion process that destroys structure in a data distribution and a learned reverse diffusion process that restores structure.
significance: A documented generative-model research milestone that explicitly formulates learned reverse diffusion for data generation and likelihood-based modeling.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the March 12 2015 submission date, title, authors, and the forward/reverse diffusion formulation. The ICML 2015 PMLR proceedings independently corroborate the paper and its publication in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research volume 37. No invention date, first-ever claim, development geography, institutional affiliation, ancestry, influence, causality, relationship edge, or claim about later diffusion systems is inferred.
